about: Mat Gallery photo holds. ONE rule = the CLAUDE.md FYM low bar: a photo stays if the mat and its colours are clearly readable (tiles/racks on it are fine); held = no mat edge at all (fabric close-up), a different product, or too far/small. builder/fym_fix_nov06/gallery_sync.py leaves these out until a clearer photo exists. Nov 6 QA re-check: Paint Party, Turkey Dinner, Poppylicious, Acid in the Library, Primary on Broughton, Deep Blue, All Vibes came back (racks/tiles on a readable mat; Deep Blue/All Vibes = solids). 'imgs' = gallery rows held by gallery img id (catalog rows that are not FYM-synced); build_v6.py removes them.
